description:
Get the balance

The prepaid balance and how to top it up from code: over x402 with USDC (when switched on) or with a card link for a person (the `create_topup_checkout` tool). Takes an agent session or a management key like every v1 operation; a model key gets 403 wrong_key_type. Also served at /v1/balance, which also accepts the account's model keys (kl_live_).
name: get_balance
title: Get the balance
